english.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice when something is suitable or appropriate for a purpose or situation.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that something is suitable or fits the situation.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that something is suitable or right for a purpose or occasion.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something suitable, appropriate, or fitting.
Use this when acceptable means suitable, appropriate, or right for a person or purpose.
Use 啱 as the everyday adjective for something suitable, proper, or appropriate.
